clips.title: The story
paras: Mo'grosh Stronghold is a fortified den of ogres dug into the northeastern hills of Loch Modan. Nestled among ancient, weathered ruins, these brutal giants pose a constant threat to the dwarven settlements below.

Tucked away in the crags of northeastern Loch Modan, Mo'grosh Stronghold serves as the primary base for the Mo'grosh clan of ogres in the region. The brute forces lurking within the caves and outer camps raid traveling dwarven supply caravans and present an enduring danger to the peace of Thelsamar. The rugged stonework scattered around the camp suggests the site once belonged to an older settlement, likely trolls, before the lumbering ogres claimed the territory and raised their distinctive mounds.
